in_marathi.name: Jannu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jannu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jannu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jani', meaning 'born'. The name Jannu signifies 'God's Grace' or 'Born of God'. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring blessings and prosperity to the one who bears it.
